channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
item.description: The llama.cpp × AMD Benchmark dashboard on Hugging Face tracks prompt processing and text generation (PP512/TG128, including Radeon 8060S) across llama.cpp builds, models and quantizations on Ryzen and Radeon hardware, with public data. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: 30B Beats 120B! Sakana AI Releases Namazu Small: 3B Active Parameters Put an End to Enterprise AI's "Compute Anxiety
item.description: Sakana AI's Namazu Small, with 30B total parameters and 3B activated per token, averaged 60.1 across 25 self-built benchmarks, beating the 120B Nemotron3Super and challenging enterprise assumptions that bigger models always win. (AIbase)

item.title: 90 Days From Empty Land to Compute Behemoth: SpaceX Spends $24 Billion to Build Its Own Energy Island
item.description: SpaceX built multiple buildings for its Texas StarBase AI supercomputing campus in under 90 days across 444 acres, investing over $24 billion and installing Tesla Megapack storage to bypass power and construction bottlenecks. (AIbase)

item.title: JetBrains survey of nearly 30,000 developers: 96% already use AI tools, but 46% feel a diminished sense of ownership over their code
item.description: JetBrains surveyed 28,945 developers and found 96% use AI coding tools, with Claude Code leading at 39%, while 46% report less code ownership and 58% spend more time reviewing AI-generated code. (AIbase)

item.title: SAP reportedly plans to cut at least 10,000 jobs in an "AI-first" bet, affecting 9% of its global workforce, with product and engineering and sales hit hardest
item.description: SAP is reportedly planning to cut at least 10,000 jobs, about 9% of its global workforce, with product and engineering and sales teams most affected, and the article examines why the company is pushing an "AI first" restructuring even as its results hit new highs. (AIbase)

item.title: Farewell to “topology hell” and “texture duds”: Tencent Hunyuan launches Hy3D 3.6, with native 3D generation taking direct aim at professional pipeline pain points
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan's Hy3D 3.6, released November 27, targets AI 3D models' messy topology, unusable UVs and non-physical materials that block direct import into game engines and film pipelines, using native 3D learning from large asset collections. (AIbase)

item.title: Japan's largest power company JERA teams up with five tech giants to build AI data centers on-site at its power plants
item.description: Japan’s largest power company JERA is negotiating with Anthropic, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft and Google to build AI data centers beside a Tokyo power plant, cutting transmission losses. (AIbase)

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI, a painstakingly human-made game, became one of the most successful entertainment launches of all time on the same day Anthropic entered the public market, illustrating the article's case that efficiency isn't a virtue. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: Transept AI — Translate your book in your own voice and prove authorship
item.description: Transept AI claims it can translate an entire book in the author's own voice while offering proof of authorship, though the original page sits behind a CAPTCHA and leaves implementation details unverified. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Moonshot AI opens its Kimi research support program to natural sciences and engineering, offering API credits and technical support
item.description: Moonshot AI opened applications on Nov. 27 for its Kimi research support program, offering selected natural-science, engineering and interdisciplinary researchers research-based Kimi API quotas, priority access to new models and technical support. (AIbase)

item.title: The group chat where your AI talks about you behind your back
item.description: The group chat where your AI talks about you behind your back (construct22.com)

item.title: Google fixes Chrome Gemini memory issue: a single tab once consumed 8.4GB, and even logged-out sessions could climb to 1.3GB
item.description: Google has fixed a Chrome Gemini memory bug that let one tab peak at 8.4GB, with logged-out sessions reaching 1.3GB after Reddit and Chromium tracker complaints. (AIbase)

item.title: QA.tech MCP — Verify every change from your IDE with QA agents
item.description: QA.tech's MCP promises IDE-side verification of every change via QA agents, but the page body returns 403 Forbidden, so the actual product details remain unloaded and unverified. (Product Hunt)

item.title: AI makes self-hosting fun again
item.description: Jan-Lukas Else explains how AI coding agents handling Docker Compose configurations in Git revived his faded self-hosting enthusiasm, letting him adopt NixOS more broadly and build a Debian-based bootc image for a VPS, cutting setups that once took at least a week down to half a day. (janlukas.blog)

item.title: Google will require AI agents to use its MCP servers. Its Gmail agent, however, cannot send emails.
item.description: Google will require AI agents to use its MCP servers. Its Gmail agent, however, cannot send emails. (techstackups.com)

item.title: Doubao lands exclusive integration in CapCut, using conversational interaction to reshape the video creation workflow
item.description: Doubao Work's exclusive integration with the official CapCut plugin lets creators edit spoken videos by typing commands such as deleting a repeated filler in the third paragraph, fixing a fifth-second slip, and adding white-outlined bold subtitles. (AIbase)

item.title: Tracking the diseases AI has cured
item.description: Tracking the diseases AI has cured (diseasescuredbyai.com)

item.title: New AI research suggests AI bubble bursting and to expect major market collapse
item.description: An LLM analysis of 795,964 Economist articles since 1843, including about 486,000 market-related pieces, puts the probability that AI stocks are in a bubble at up to 97%, urging leaders to prepare for a crash.

item.title: First farming-civilization large model Tianji released, using 80 million data records to bridge the gap between ancient and modern agriculture
item.description: China’s Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs released Tianji, the first farming-civilization large model, integrating 80 million knowledge entries spanning traditional farming techniques, modern smart agriculture and agricultural civilization, using a multimodal model and spatiotemporal knowledge graph to bridge the gap between ancient and modern agricultural knowledge. (AIbase)
